nodes.label: Review Protocol Template
nodes.rationale: Written in stage 1 before any search runs; the criteria ids defined here are the only ids screening may cite and are never renumbered after screening starts — deviations are appended and logged instead.

nodes.label: Protocol Deviations Log
nodes.rationale: Append-only, newest last, recording every departure from the locked protocol so the strategy stays auditable rather than retroactively tidy.
